title: rust-daq universal device manifest
description: Schema for TOML device manifests parsed by driver-universal.

extends.description: Optional path to a parent manifest this file inherits from.

commands.description: Named command definitions. Key is the command name.

responses.description: Named response-parser definitions. Key is the response name referenced by commands.

parameters.description: Device parameter metadata. Key is the parameter name.

template.description: MiniJinja template for the outgoing command (e.g. 'MOVE {{ position }}').

parameters.description: Expected parameter types, keyed by name.

response.description: Name of the response parser (from [responses.*]) to apply to the reply.

response_type.description: SCPI auto-parse type; alternative to an explicit [responses.*] entry.

conversion.description: Name of a conversion formula to apply (from [conversions.*]).

command_ui.description: Inline UI declaration for a command (bd-jcb4x G1). Feeds Phase 2 G2 ControlPanelConfig auto-synthesis; no effect on runtime.

label.description: Human-readable button / widget label. Defaults to the command name.

widget_hint.description: Suggested widget shape. Omit to let the synthesizer pick from command shape.

group.description: Named group for clustering related widgets (e.g. 'motion', 'status'). Seeds Phase 2 G3 layout slots.

description.description: Tooltip / help text. Falls back to the command's top-level description.

parameter_ui.description: Inline UI declaration for a parameter (bd-jcb4x G1). Feeds Phase 2 G2 ControlPanelConfig auto-synthesis; no effect on runtime.

label.description: Human-readable label. Defaults to the parameter name.

widget_hint.description: Suggested widget shape. Omit to let the synthesizer pick from dtype + range.

group.description: Named group for clustering related parameters.

step.description: Slider / numeric-input step size. Only meaningful for numeric widgets.

enum_values.description: Discrete allowed values for enum_select widgets. Ignored for other shapes.

response.description: A response-parser definition. Choose exactly one tier: format/variants (preferred), transform, or regex (escape hatch).

format.description: Single format template, e.g. '{addr:hex1}PO{pulses:hex8}'. Equivalent to variants = [format].

variants.description: Multiple format templates tried in order; first match wins.

regex.description: Regex with named capture groups. DEPRECATED at top level: prefer 'variants' or move under [responses.X.advanced].

fields.description: Legacy v1 field type declarations for regex captures (ignored in v3).

response_advanced.description: Escape-hatch parsing options. Placing regex here silences the deprecation warning emitted by a top-level regex.

formula.description: evalexpr formula. Variables available: value, plus manifest-level constants.

capabilities.description: Capability → command wiring. Keys like 'movable', 'readable', 'settable', 'shutter_control', etc.
